[[Strawberry seeds]] can purchased from a [[shop]] during the [[Egg Festival]] or from [[Oasis]] in the [[Calico Desert]]. They can be grown during [[Spring]] and take 8 days to mature and will keep producing fruit after 4 days. They sell through the [[shipping bin]] for 120g, 150g at silver [[quality]], and 180g at gold quality. Strawberry [[Jelly]] sells for 290g each. Strawberry [[Wine]] sells for 360g.
== Growing == Strawberries can be grown by planting [[strawberry seeds]] and watering them for 8 days. After harvest, strawberries will continue to grow from the original plant until the end of the [[season]].

They can be grown during the Summer and take 11 days to mature and keeps producing everyday. They sell through the shipping container for No Star: 25g, Silver: 31g, Gold: 37g each.
You cannot walk through hops at any stage of growth.
== Used In: == * Pale Ale == Notes == Hops do have a special way of growing, after reaching the matured state hops will be grown each day making it a vital source for creating pale ale with the use of a [[keg]]. Pale ale sells for 300g or for 420g if the players chooses the artisan talent upon reaching max farming skill; so hops generate a lot of money when grown in bulk in combination with brewing.
While it is possible to make a tidy profit by selling the raw fruit if you can set up a large amount of kegs you will be able to produce pale ale year round using your stockpiles.

{{Stub}} '''Tea Leaves''' are a [[crop]] harvested from [[Tea Sapling]]s in [[Spring]], [[Summer]], and [[Fall]], as well as [[Winter]] when planted indoors using [[Garden Pots]] or the [[Greenhouse]].
A Tea Sapling is given after completing [[Caroline's]] 2nd [[friendship]] event, as well as the [[Seed Maker]] crafting recipe. They take 20 days to mature and can be harvested every day on the last week of each month (days 22 through 28, for a total of 7 leaves). Tea Saplings don't die between [[season]] changes, and will continue to grow outdoors in Winter but wont produce any leaves.
== Usage == Tea leaves can be placed in a [[Keg]] to make [[Green Tea]], whch restores 5 Health, 13 Energy, and gives a +30 increase to maximum energy.
